name: talking-shit-api
description: A tiny, read-only API for curated developer roasts by category and intensity.

scripts.format: biome check --write src test scripts vitest.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json wrangler.jsonc
scripts.lint: biome ci src test scripts vitest.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json wrangler.jsonc
scripts.verify: npm run policy && npm run lint && npm run types && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run shell:check && npm run build:check && npm run deps:policy && npm run audit
scripts.deployment:state: wrangler deployments status --json && wrangler versions list --json
scripts.candidate:upload: npm run verify && npm audit signatures && wrangler versions upload
